subject: Inference Exchange: Local Labs & Hybrid Panel — playbook, budget split, and calendar
messages:
From: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@edgeops.io>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
Cc: partners@metapulse.com, jane.liu@brightlane.com
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: joint local 'Inference Exchange' labs + hybrid panel series

Hi Sofia,

Hope you’re well — Alex here from EdgeOps. We loved Redwood’s demo at Summit and wanted to propose a joint local activation series we’re calling "Inference Exchange: Local Labs & Hybrid Panel". High level: 3 x market-specific half-day labs (SF, Austin, Boston) paired with one live-streamed panel that ties the three together. Goals: drive qualified leads for both companies, showcase real-world latency/cost wins, and produce on-demand content for demand gen.

We can fund up to $30k MDF per market (subject to a short MOU), handle venue ops, and bring 2 engineers per city. We’d like Redwood to lead one breakout per city and co-brand the registration flow. Proposed timing: Oct 2026 kickoff (SF), Nov (Austin), Dec (Boston), final panel in Jan 2027.

If this is interesting I can send a one-page playbook and a rough budget. Are you the right contact or should I loop someone else from your events/partnerships team?

Best,
Alex Reynolds
Head of Partnerships — EdgeOps
alex.reynolds@edgeops.io
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: edgeops-inference-exec-summary.pdf (summary)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@edgeops.io>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: joint local 'Inference Exchange' labs + hybrid panel series

Thanks Alex — this sounds promising.

Kimberly (field marketing) and Jordan (partnerships) are cc’d to scope logistics and MDF terms. A couple quick asks from our side before we dive into schedules:
- Can you share the one-page playbook and a draft budget (line items and assumptions)?
- Is EdgeOps expecting co-marketing credit or lead ownership rules per market?
- Any exclusivity in attendee lists or vendors (e.g., AV/food)?

High-level constraints on our side: we need a short playbook we can map to our FY26/Ops calendar and a clear MDF MOU. For staffing, we can commit a Redwood engineer to each market (travel TBD) and 2 local AE/day as needed.

If you can send the playbook and budget I’ll pull a first-pass draft for budget split and an initial staff rota. I’ve attached a template playbook we use for partner activations — feel free to adapt.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Field Marketing — Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: event-playbook-v1.pdf (Redwood playbook template)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@edgeops.io>
Cc: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: joint local 'Inference Exchange' labs + hybrid panel series

Looping in Marissa for ops (venues, staffing). Quick first pass on MDF/expense split thinking:
- Budget baseline per market: venue + AV + catering + local promo + small speaker stipend = ~$45k.
- EdgeOps proposal of $30k MDF/market is a great start; suggest Redwood contributes $10k/market to hit full coverage in SF and Austin (higher venue costs).
- Shared registration & lead routing: leads split 50/50 for joint registration. For demo signups and deep-qualification, we propose lead ownership rules based on contact intent (AE follow-up for explicit demo interest).

I attached a proposed-budget-edgeops.xlsx with a sample cost breakdown and an MDF MOU checklist we require (insurance, indemnity, data handling — quick items for Legal). Proposed staffing: 1 Redwood engineer + 1 AE (SF), 1 engineer + 1 AE (Austin), 1 engineer + roaming AE (Boston) + central streaming lead for the panel.

Questions for EdgeOps: do you have preferred vendors for AV/streaming? If you can share vendor contacts we can try to compress local contracting. Also, we should pick provisional market dates this week so travel can be booked.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Field Marketing Manager — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: proposed-budget-edgeops.xlsx
From: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@edgeops.io>
To: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
Cc: partners@metapulse.com, jane.liu@brightlane.com
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: joint local 'Inference Exchange' labs + hybrid panel series

Hi Kimberly / Sofia — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is our one-page playbook and a draft budget that mirrors your spreadsheet. Quick notes:
- We use StreamLine AV (San Jose/ Austin/ Boston) and can route their contact for each market — they handle multi-camera streaming and on-site encoding.
- On lead ownership: 50/50 registration capture is fine. For demo-qualified leads we’re comfortable with the AE routing idea; we’ll mirror your MQL rules in our CRM.
- No vendor exclusivity, but we do prefer StreamLine for consistent streaming.

We’re OK with the MDF split you suggested; once Legal signs the MOU we’ll wire MDF on a per-market basis (milestone: venue contract + co-branded registration live). I uploaded a DocuSign MOU draft to the link below.

Attached: edgeops-playbook-v1.pdf, edgeops-draft-budget.xlsx
DocuSign MOU: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/EDGEOPS-MOU-2026

If those look good, can we lock provisional dates? Suggested: SF: 2026-10-19, Austin: 2026-11-09, Boston: 2026-12-07, Hybrid panel: 2027-01-18 (afternoon PST).

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Reynolds
Head of Partnerships — EdgeOps

1) Legal/Finance: Jordan to intake EdgeOps MOU and run standard MDF review (Jordan) — target internal sign-off by 2026-09-20. (Jordan)
2) Ops/Venue & Staff: Marissa to confirm venue shortlist and AV vendor availability (Marissa) — venue shortlist due 2026-09-17.
3) Budget & MDF: Kimberly to finalize the proposed split and invoice schedule and share final spreadsheet (Kimberly) — due 2026-09-15.
4) Content & Speakers: Sofia to draft session outlines and co-branding guidelines; will share the draft playbook (Sofia) — due 2026-09-14.
5) CRM & Registration: Jonas to create HubSpot event record and set lead routing. HubSpot ID: HS-45392. Jonas to add co-branded landing page requirements.

I uploaded a shared calendar (.ics) with provisional dates and added tasks to the shared doc. Once Legal says go on the MOU we’ll execute the DocuSign link Alex provided.

Action owners — please reply with any blockers. Alex — can you confirm StreamLine’s contact and whether EdgeOps prefers any special language in the MOU around data handling (we will require standard Redwood data protections)?

Thanks all — exciting to get this moving.

— Sofia
